Important: The test conducting agency, would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual
candidates with other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If
in the analytical procedure adopted by test conducting agency in this regard, it is inferred/
concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, in
such cases LIC HFL reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and
the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
Candidates shortlisted based on the entrance examination result will be invited for Document
Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices (refer Table D for dates).
